verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rich gateway logging, including prompts, responses, tokens, cost and duration, with per-request log controls. Marketing copy says this logging and metrics data can feed 'comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems', which hints that the data can be used outside the dashboard. However, nothing in the pack describes an actual export path to an external observability stack, and logs appear to be viewed mainly in the Cloudflare dashboard. Missing for 10: documented log export/push (e.g. Logpush or a log-retrieval API), trace export (e.g. OpenTelemetry), named integrations with third-party observability tools, and hands-on corroboration.
